packages.title: Independent agronomic validation and reference field program

assessment.current_behavior: Ground-truth registry stores plot-scoped evidence and derives heuristic metadata QA. It supplies fallback coverage/RMSE/raster dimensions/geography for drone evidence, with authority boosts also requiring caller flags. Retrovalidation implements training-only scene holdouts and evaluator implements teacher agreement. These are not measurements from a preregistered independent agronomic field program.
verified_slices: Static evidence schema/registry, holdout and evaluator inspection.
No empirical campaign, sample collection, instruments, agronomic outcomes or intervention study executed.
remaining_criteria: Preregister target/horizon/cohort and instrument/reference calibration with independent sampling and lineage.
Depth-resolved water/EC, delivered irrigation, canopy/phenology and agronomic outcome references.
Blocked baselines, calibrated uncertainty, nuisance-discriminating interventions and field support/domain limits.
Missing drone quality/reference measurements must remain unknown rather than plausible QA defaults.
assessment.nextstep: Make independent reference/measurement and preregistration contracts explicit, reject missing metrology from physical QA, and execute the field program with holdout and baseline plans.
assessment.acceptance_scope: No conclusion about real-world field accuracy or absence of all external data is possible from code. T12 remains an acquisition/research acceptance target in this bounded review.
